patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AI InteleKt and Zapier share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AI InteleKt only if your buying job matches “AI InteleKt is a customer data and retail intelligence platform — unify POS, web, and mobi” rather than Zapier's shape. Choose Zapier only if your buying job matches “Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks); Team from 2,000 t” rather than AI InteleKt's shape. Workflow advantage: AI InteleKt leans marketing-automation; Zapier leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Workflow coverage skew: AI InteleKt-leaning marketing-automation vs Zapier-leaning —.
- Researched limits: AI InteleKt — none listed; Zapier — Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast.

Limitations — AI InteleKt: —; Zapier: Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast; Agents add-on is separate from the Pro $19.99 floor.
